notes: "Story keeps the reason for the work available after the conversation ends. At the project level it records the purpose of the talk. On a page it records the point being made and what an edit must preserve. This scientific example keeps the structure, twelve values and source attribution. Story gives both the agent and my future self context; it is not a switch that guarantees judgment."

designIntent.purpose: Story keeps the reason for the work available after the conversation ends.
keep: Keep source figures, labels, measured values and citations
Keep intentional background roles, product identity and meaningful density
